description: Search Polish companies in the KRS (National Court Register) by name or partial name ("query"), KRS, NIP or REGON. Returns matching entities with their padded 10-digit KRS numbers — use this FIRST to resolve a company name to a KRS number before calling get_company / get_company_full / get_board.

query.description: Company name or partial name. This is the only tool that can resolve a company NAME to a KRS number.

registries.description: Registries to search: P = entrepreneurs, S = associations.

name: search_companies
title: Search the KRS registry
